name: silu_half2_neg
desc: half-precision SiLu(d0)*d1 (cutlass LeftSiLUAndMul, ElementCompute=half). Regression for the half2 REGISTER-operand negation bug: -Rx.H0_H0 in HADD2.F32/HSETP2 was integer-negated (packed f16x2 word) instead of per-lane fneg, degenerating the sigmoid to a near-step function.
